description: This source file implements filename utility functions for safe path validation and filename generation based on URLs, including handling of internationalization and platform-specific considerations.

methods.name: IsSafePortablePathComponent
methods.description: Checks if a given file path component is safe for portable use, considering filename legality, reserved names, and extension restrictions.

methods.name: IsSafePortableRelativePath
methods.description: Validates if a relative path is safe for portable use by checking each component.

methods.name: GetSuggestedFilename
methods.description: Generates a suggested filename based on URL and content disposition, with internationalization considerations.

methods.name: GenerateFileName
methods.description: Creates a filename for a download or file operation based on URL, content disposition, and other parameters, with platform-specific normalization.
